faqs.question: What should I send for a timber window repair in Adelaide CBD?
faqs.answer: The street, symptom and access arrangements are enough to start. Photos and approximate sizes are optional; if available, include the frame and moving parts. The assessment then establishes the repair scope and any adjoining work.

faqs.question: Can you help with a timber door that no longer closes properly?
faqs.answer: We inspect the door, frame, hinges, hardware and surrounding trim on site to identify why the door binds and confirm the adjustment or repair scope and quote.

faqs.question: How quickly will MEL ONE respond to a CBD enquiry?
faqs.answer: Contact the team during the published hours, seven days from 09:00 to 21:00 Adelaide time. Response and assessment arrangements depend on availability and the work required; confirm the appointment and any assessment charges before booking.

regions.repairTitle: CBD Timber Doors, Windows and Interior Joinery
repairParagraphs: A sticking door may need hinge or latch adjustment, local frame repair or a wider opening assessment. Describe where it catches and whether nearby trim has moved. For a timber window, identify the damaged sill, frame or moving part; the visit checks accessible timber, hardware and adjoining finishes before repair or replacement is specified.

Jambs, architraves and skirting can be considered with the opening they surround. For cabinetry, custom details or refurbishment, explain the intended use and which dimensions, finishes and other trades are already decided. Decks, gates and fences need separate checks of exposed timber, supports, moisture and access.
regions.accessTitle: Pirie Street, Currie Street and Building Access
accessParagraphs: Give the street, property type and room or outdoor area involved. Note occupied rooms, stairs or lifts, parking, loading and any actual building-manager requirements. Confirm who can authorise the visit and approve the work, particularly where access or timber belongs to a shared area.

Photos and approximate dimensions are optional. If useful, send a wide view and a close detail, then describe sticking, splitting, movement or dampness. The assessment establishes the accessible condition; the written quote should identify retained timber, replacement parts, concealed conditions and any separately arranged trade work.

faqs.question: What information helps with an East End joinery enquiry?

faqs.question: Does MEL ONE handle timber preservation and moisture-related questions?
faqs.answer: We can discuss visible timber condition, weather exposure and moisture concerns as part of a practical maintenance or repair assessment; the location of the affected timber is helpful, and photos are optional.

regions.repairTitle: East End Window Repairs and Interior Timber Details
repairParagraphs: For a sticking sash, rubbing door or opening trim joint, describe what has changed and whether it happens intermittently. The assessment checks accessible timber, hardware and adjoining surfaces before a local repair or replacement is specified. Existing profiles and finishes help define what should be retained or matched.

Second-fix work can include skirting, jambs, architraves and custom joinery details. For a deck, fence or gate, identify the loose or damaged part, visible water exposure and access to the supports. Repair decisions depend on the condition of the connected timber, not only the visible board or finish.
regions.accessTitle: Rundle Street, Hutt Street and Access for Repairs

Photos and approximate measurements are optional. A wide image, close detail and description of the part that binds, moves or leaks can help prepare the visit. The written scope should record repairs, matching expectations, adjoining finishes, access and any specialist responsibilities before work is booked.

regions.repairTitle: West End Door Repairs, Fitouts and Outdoor Timber
repairParagraphs: A door that will not latch may involve the leaf, hinges, frame or hardware. Describe the operation problem before choosing a repair. The visit checks accessible opening and window-frame conditions, then separates a local repair from replacement of a damaged component.

For a fitout or refurbishment, identify which joinery dimensions and service positions are confirmed and how trim, jambs and cabinetry meet other finishes. Deck restoration, fences and gates need their own checks of condition, drainage or exposure, boundaries and access. Keep immediate maintenance separate from planned refurbishment.
regions.accessTitle: Gouger Street, Hindley Street and Occupied Premises
accessParagraphs: Give the street, entry point, accessible rooms and any business operating hours or work windows. regions.repairTitle: North Terrace and Riverbank Timber Repairs

For fine joinery, describe the intended use and finish expectations. Decks, fences, gates and weather-exposed window or door timber also need moisture, drainage and maintenance observations. A surface finish does not establish the condition of concealed timber or its supports.

regions.repairTitle: North Adelaide Timber Windows, Trim and Outdoor Repairs
repairParagraphs: For timber windows, doors or older trim, identify the affected component, visible wear, movement or moisture signs and what you want to retain. Home renovation work can bring together openings, second-fix trim, storage and cabinetry. Outdoor enquiries may concern deck boards, fencing, gates or exposed joinery; describe the connected supports and moisture exposure as well as the damaged surface. Structural concerns need their own assessment and approved scope.
